stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Some cars carry conversation.”?
options: It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.
Respecting rules in shared spaces is a way of letting strangers rest.
A shared ocean needs shared rules, or everyone loses.
Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.
